    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.ExactClassGroup.torsion_identifies_support {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] (T : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C) [T.IsClosedUnderExtensions] [T.IsClosedUnderQuotients] (h₀ : T 0) (length : ∀ (X : C), ∃ (l : Multiset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton C)), HasCompositionFactors X l) :
    Function.Injective ⇑(inclusion T) ∧ (inclusion T).range = supportSubgroup T

    In a length abelian category the inclusion of a torsion class identifies its inherited Grothendieck group with the subgroup on its composition factors.
